queries_run: Shopify market share ecommerce platform 2026 gaining OR losing
Shopify new entrant threat agentic commerce OpenAI Stripe displace 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 自述：電商市場高度分散，成長可能吸引新進入者或既有對手的新產品；商家也可能改選支付處理商、CMS、市集等整合或單點方案。
findings.excerpt: The growth of ecommerce may attract new entrants or new offerings from existing competitors. Additionally, some merchants may select one or more integrated or standalone offerings from other providers such as: •ecommerce software vendors; •content management systems; •payment processors; •point of sale providers;

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：對手有更長歷史、更大客群與資源，可能以更積極定價或整合競爭平台；定價決策可能導致失去市占。
findings.excerpt: Some of our larger competitors may be able to leverage a larger installed customer base and distribution network to adopt more aggressive pricing policies and offer more attractive sales terms, which could cause us to lose potential sales or to sell our solutions at lower prices.

findings.claim: 2026 年行銷公司爬蟲報告稱 Shopify 占電商店家 42.6%（2022 年 31.8%），WooCommerce 24.6%（2022 年 32.4%）；單一非獨立來源，口徑不一。
評論稱 AI 平台（OpenAI／Google）若接管結帳，Shopify 商家關係護城河可能受挑戰；OpenAI 於 2026-03 撤下 ChatGPT Instant Checkout。
findings.excerpt: OpenAI pulled ChatGPT Instant Checkout in March 2026, while Google and Shopify pushed the Universal Commerce Protocol.34 The hype gap is in trust, not capability.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 份額數據皆為行銷部落格、口徑互相矛盾，無獨立研究機構或公司一手份額資料；未搜尋 design win 與同業比較兩類。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
